No snow-reliable terrain exists locally; the nearest dog sledding is in the Adirondacks, several hours away.
No glaciers exist nearby; the nearest are in Alaska, Canada or Iceland.

No volcanoes exist in the region; the activity is offered at Cerro Negro in Nicaragua.
No desert exists locally; real sandboarding and desert trekking means the US Southwest or beyond, a flight away.
